name: lumos
description: Project Lumos - Full-cloud offline-first memos, calendar, and #agy inbox.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:watcher
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lumos/web && npm run typecheck -w @lumos/watcher
scripts.watcher:install: npm run build:watcher && node src/watcher/dist/watcher/src/control.js install
scripts.watcher:start: npm run build:watcher && node src/watcher/dist/watcher/src/control.js start
scripts.push:test: npm run build:watcher && node src/watcher/dist/watcher/src/inbox.js test-push
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npx firebase-tools deploy
